component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
' A RowList shaped like a home grid: tall poster rows with a one-item banner row between them, fixedFocus, ' and a focusXOffset on the poster rows. Every in-transit currFocusRow/currFocusColumn value and every ' settle field logs subBoundingRect("item<row>_<col>") of a fixed set of items, to show whether item rects ' follow the scroll or report a static layout while the list moves. The last phase repeats the moves ' with skipFocusAnimations set, the device's own instant mode. sub init() m.seq = 0 m.timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "runSteps") m.steps = [ { op: "create" }, { op: "wait", secs: 2 }, { op: "mark", what: "initial" }, { op: "key", key: "Down" }, { op: "key", key: "Up" }, { op: "key", key: "Right" }, { op: "key", key: "Left" }, { op: "key", key: "Down" }, { op: "key", key: "Down" }, { op: "key", key: "Up" }, { op: "skip" }, { op: "key", key: "Up" }, { op: "key", key: "Right" }, { op: "key", key: "Left" }, { op: "key", key: "Down" }, { op: "done" } ] m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub rec(phase as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 print "PROBE|" + right("00" + m.seq.toStr(), 3) + "|" + phase + "|" + detail end sub
sub runSteps() while m.steps.count() > 0 s = m.steps.shift() if s.op = "create" createList() else if s.op = "wait" m.timer.duration = s.secs m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "skip" m.list.skipFocusAnimations = true rec("mark", "skipFocusAnimations=" + m.list.skipFocusAnimations.toStr() + rects()) else if s.op = "mark" rec("mark", s.what + " " + rects()) else if s.op = "key" rec("await", s.key + "|") m.timer.duration = 3 m.timer.control = "start" return else if s.op = "done" rec("done", "end") m.top.probeExit = true return end if end while end sub
sub createList() colors = ["0x3060C0FF", "0xC03060FF", "0x30A060FF", "0xA08020FF", "0x8040C0FF"] counts = [8, 1, 8, 8, 8] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for r = 0 to counts.count() - 1 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") row.title = "row" + r.toStr() for c = 0 to counts[r] - 1 item = row.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = r.toStr() + "_" + c.toStr() item.hdPosterUrl = colors[(r + c) mod colors.count()] end for end for l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "RowList") l.id = "list" l.translation = [160, 144] l.itemComponentName = "ProbeItem" l.itemSize = [1613, 442] l.numRows = 3 l.rowFocusAnimationStyle = "fixedFocus" l.vertFocusAnimationStyle = "fixedFocus" l.showRowLabel = [true, false, true, true, true] l.rowItemSpacing = [[16, 0]] l.rowItemSize = [[310, 442], [1613, 120], [310, 442], [310, 442], [310, 442]] l.rowHeights = [530, 160, 530, 530, 530] l.focusXOffset = [490, 0, 0, 0, 0] l.content = root m.top.appendChild(l) m.list = l for each f in ["currFocusRow", "currFocusColumn", "scrollingStatus", "rowItemFocused"] l.observeField(f, "onListField") end for l.setFocus(true) rec("create", "rows=" + root.getChildCount().toStr()) end sub
function fmtRect(r) as string return r.x.toStr() + "," + r.y.toStr() + "," + r.width.toStr() + "," + r.height.toStr() end function
' The rects of a fixed set of items: two in row 0, the banner, the focused column of rows 2 and 3. function rects() as string l = m.list out = "" for each id in ["item0_0", "item0_1", "item1_0", "item2_0", "item3_0"] out = out + " " + id + "=" + fmtRect(l.subBoundingRect(id)) end for return out end function
sub onListField(msg) l = m.list v = msg.getData() if type(v) = "roArray" v = FormatJson(v) else v = v.toStr() end if rec("field", msg.getField() + "=" + v + rects()) end sub
